messages:
ashley: FYI rolling out Dedicated capacity for prod-2 is showing a P95 increase (~220ms vs baseline ~140ms) across reserved pools for the last 10m. Not full outage but this is trending toward SLA violation. Observed right after merge r3456.

oncall-bot: Alert: p95 spike on prod-2 reserved pools for tenant-42 > SLA threshold. https://infra/alerts/1234

sam: Is this only for long sequences or all traffic?

ashley: Mostly longseq (>1024) and a chunk of medium requests. KV miss rate jumped ~2.5x. Autobatcher effective batch sizes dropped and we see a lot of kernel fallback churn — looks like per-request kernel swaps.

michael: I profiled node-7 for 5m. Kernel-selection loop is thrashing; kernel swap + KV rebind adds ~3-5ms per token and gets amplified by high churn. Quick flame snippet: 
```text
kernel_select()  45.2%
swap_kv()        12.8%
wait_for_batch() 18.1%
```

sam: Which change introduced the new fallback behavior? r3456? That PR added prefer_small_kernel_on_mismatch = true by default.

ashley: Yep r3456. I toggled the flag locally and p95 goes back to baseline. With it on we hit oscillation.

michael: If that's the lever we can flip it via rollout-policy for prod-2 as an emergency config. Need infra approval for hot config flip.

jane: CI for r3456 did show a small perf regression on heavy-seq tests (~2-3%), but it was under the gate at the time. The regression looks non-linear in production because of batching interactions.

infra-sig: saw the thread — we'll approve emergency config flip for prod-2. Also recommend enabling KV-prefetch boost for longseq as a secondary mitigation.

ashley: I'll flip prefer_small_kernel_on_mismatch=false on prod-2 and pause the rest of the rollout. Creating a revert PR as a safety net.

sam: +1 to hold rollout. Also we should add a CI canary that simulates kernel-fallback oscillation (mix of long/medium seqs with randomized kernel hints).

michael: I'll add extra logs to emit kernel decision reason + KV-prefetch stats so we can correlate in future. Adding profiling artifacts to the revert PR.

ashley: Thanks — flipping flag now, then will post follow-up metrics. Will notify impacted tenants after we confirm recovery. :thumbsup:
thread_text_summary: Dedicated prod-2 rollout caused p95 spike after r3456 enabling small-kernel fallback; KV miss rate up, kernel selection thrashing. Team approves emergency config flip (prefer_small_kernel_on_mismatch=false), rollout paused, revert PR as safety net, CI canary and extra logs requested.
